report.summary:
Patient P-D010 (Gregory Nowak, 55, commercial Employer PPO, no transport benefit) seen today at V-D010. Screener (2026-10-21) reports no transportation need and no utilities shutoff concern. Home tract 17031100500 (Chicago 60656): low vehicle-ownership (3.6% no-vehicle), one transit stop within 800m with early service; low-income share 0.0%. One appointment today (appt:2, primary care 08:00, kept) — transit feasibility could not be computed because no facility location is on file for that appointment.

Utilities: Patient screened negative for shutoff risk, but options identified. Lakeside Energy Assistance eligibility was verified via the partner API — ELIGIBLE (eligible=true). Neighborhood Energy Help (income-based gas/electric help, apply in person Mon/Wed) and Shutoff Prevention Clinic (walk-in disconnection-notice help, Tuesdays) are also available.

Transport: No transport benefit on commercial plan. Medicaid Ride Line requires Medicaid (not eligible). Senior Shuttle West is for ages 60+ (patient is 55, not eligible). Paratransit Info Desk offers ADA paratransit certification by phone (up to 21-day decision). Lakeside Energy Assistance appears under transport in the directory but is an energy program, not a ride resource.
